shots.narration_english: 'Father... everything you lost has come back to you today.' Looking at her father with tear-filled eyes, Layaali put the papers in Qaasim's hands.

shots.narration_dhivehi: "ޒާހިރުގެ މުޅި ކުންފުނި މިހާރު އެވަނީ ބައްޕަގެ ނަމަށް ބަދަލުވެފަ." ލަޔާލީ ދިއްކޮއްލި ލިޔުންތަކުގައި ޤާސިމް ހިފިއެވެ. ޤާސިމް އެ ލިޔުންތަކުގައި ބާރަށް ހިފަހައްޓާލިއެވެ.
shots.narration_english: 'Zaahir's whole company is now in your name.' Qaasim took the papers Layaali held out. He held on to them tightly.
